facts.rationale: Retains exact selection behavior while removing unsupported animation-pointer typing and documenting boundary/exceptional inputs.
facts.value: Resolves msid1 through x20_actionStateList[msid1-x18] when msid1 >= x18, otherwise x1C_actionStateList[msid1], then clears allow_interrupt. Selects msid1 only for facing_dir == -1.0f and a nonzero x8 in the record returned by ftData_80085FD4(fp, ms->anim_id); the query is short-circuited for other facing values. Otherwise selects msid0. Calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState with 0, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, NULL. No ID bounds or pointer checks are supplied. NaN, infinities, signed zero, and finite values other than exactly -1 select msid0 under ordinary floating comparison semantics.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline rapid-jab misclassification using active table dispatch, not rendered aliases; preserves exact canonical priority.
facts.value: Returns immediately when allow_interrupt is false. Otherwise evaluates, stopping at the first true result: ftCo_SpecialS_CheckInput, ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput, ftCo_800D6824, ftCo_800D68C0, ftCo_Catch_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackS4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackHi4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackLw4_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackS3_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackHi3_CheckInput, ftCo_AttackLw3_CheckInput, ftCo_Attack1_CheckInput, ftCo_80099794, ftCo_80091A4C. Despite its canonical name, ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput dispatches ftData_SpecialHi when the entry is non-null and x686==0, not rapid jab. The next two address-named functions similarly dispatch SpecialN with x689==0 and SpecialLw with x687==0 after null checks. This callback makes no direct motion-state write.
